_comment: In-run merge shepherd (distinct from the standalone pr-shepherd daemon). Per-transaction authority: claims one merge bead, lands or bounces, releases. Enforced at stop: holds zero claims. It legitimately writes merge_sha/pr and closes merge beads (its job — NOT denied). deny_states blocks it from setting review-verdict states on work beads; deny_metadata blocks coder delivery fields. Content-read-only (no push/edit) is unenforceable at the bead layer — it lives in the agent definition + git-safety hooks.
